About.title: About Me
About.intro: I'm a full-stack developer passionate about building modern web experiences.
About.description: I have strong hands-on experience in Front-end development using React, TypeScript, and atomic design methodology. Additionally, I've used ExpressJS and NestJS with NodeJS runtime for Back-end development. With a solid background in Agile projects, I'm passionate about using my skills to drive innovative solutions and contribute effectively to dynamic, collaborative teams.
About.full: Hello! My name is Nguyen Minh Quan (Quanngynx). I am a student pursuing a career in software development with a focus on web technologies, responsive UI engineering, and scalable backend architecture. I love combining design aesthetics with robust functional code to deliver memorable user experiences.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: A collection of web applications, experiments, and interactive experiences I've built.

items.title: Servexa Warranty AI
items.description: Agentic AI warranty operation platform for home appliance service centers, featuring RAG-based knowledge retrieval, AI copilot assistance, and Human-in-the-loop approval workflows.

items.title: Quanngynx Portfolio
items.description: Modern interactive portfolio built with Next.js App Router, Framer Motion, Lenis smooth scroll, and Tailwind CSS.

items.title: Customer Service & Warranty Management Platform
items.description: After-sales service management system for LocknLock ASC operations, supporting repair case workflows, accessory inventory, warehouse coordination, and custom reports.

items.title: READDI IELTS Platform
items.description: Internal IELTS e-learning platform with AI-powered feedback, personalized learning suggestions, test practice, result review, and learning dashboards.

items.title: Home Appliance After-Sales Service Platform
items.description: Internal management system for household appliance after-sales service, supporting inventory tracking, warranty activation, partner registration, and role-based access control.

Roadmap.title: Roadmap
Roadmap.description: Key milestones in my growth as a developer and continuous learning journey.

items.description: Started university journey in Computer Science and mastered HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals.
Expanded into modern frontend development with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Built full-stack applications using Next.js App Router, ExpressJS, NestJS, and PostgreSQL.
Refining architecture, UI animations, internationalization, and contributing to open source.
